get.description: Liveness only — the process is up. Never touches dependencies.

Readiness — reports 503 when a hard dependency is down.

Previously this returned ``ready`` unconditionally, which made it useless as a
probe: an API with an unreachable database still advertised itself as ready and
would be sent traffic it could not serve.

200.description: When stream=false: JSON batch of the same events. When stream=true: SSE frames (`event:` + `data:` JSON).

schema.description:
SSE stream. Each frame: event: <name>
data: <json>

. Event names and data shapes match ChatStreamEvent (status, token, citation, usage, verdict, done, error).

post.description:
Destroy document content irreversibly, keeping an audit record.

Chunks and embeddings are deleted outright, which cascades to the citations
that pointed at them — erased text must not survive in a stored answer. The
``documents`` and ``document_versions`` rows are retained (with ``erased_at``
set) so existing references resolve to a tombstone rather than a dangling id,
and so the erasure itself stays auditable.
Place or lift a legal hold so erasure can be blocked or re-enabled.
